notes.title: Important Update Notice
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44329362/0748cab57e22e19b29f567823491b14619d91810.png[/img]
We expect to add a new character to the game this week: Ninja;
Another update that will be released this week is the charge ability for all characters.
Use any character to reach 15 movement speed in any level to unlock the ninja (the current version only contains the base character of the ninja, the ninja's weapons and special abilities will be updated within a week).

notes.title: 2023/12/13 Update
notes.notes:
Bug fixes:
1. Fixed the bug that the upgrade option electric ring can be selected repeatedly
2. Fixed the sound effect error in the map selection interface
3. Fixed the bug where the maximum ammunition load in the lower right corner of the screen was incorrectly displayed when the maximum ammunition load was reduced to a negative number. After changing the maximum ammunition load, the overflowing ammunition will be cleared.
4. Fixed the bug where the upgrade progress was displayed incorrectly
5. Fixed the bug where guards holding scythes and several pharaohs were stuck on the terrain.
6. Fixed the bug where the ammunition of the turret is the same as that of Gatling. The ammunition fired by the turret will explode violently and cause damage in a range.

notes.title: 23/12/07 Update
notes.notes:
New content:
1. Added new upgrade option: body odor
Emits an unpleasant odor and damages nearby enemies. This damage cannot be reduced.
[img]E:\VampireLike\体臭.gif[/img]
2. Added new upgrade option: static electricity
If the shock has a jumping target, pulls the target and the shocked unit closer to each other for a short period of time
[img]E:\VampireLike\静电.gif[/img]
3. Added new upgrade option: electric ring
Knocks back enemies that are too close to the player a very long distance and inflicts a large amount of electric shock damage.
[img]E:\VampireLike\电环.gif[/img]

Adjustment:
The length of Gatling's barrel has been shortened to prevent Gatling from being unable to attack very close enemies.

Fixing:
Fixed a bug where level display was incorrect

notes.title: 23/12/6 Update
notes.notes:
Adjustment:
1. In the previous version, if the player has not unlocked other levels except Forest Cemetery, he will not enter the level selection page. Now this function is adjusted to: no matter whether other levels are unlocked or not, the level selection interface will be entered, and the unlocking conditions of the level are clearly marked in the level selection interface.
(We will add more levels later)
(Some players have reported that the level cannot be unlocked even if the unlocking conditions of the level are met. This problem is being solved)
2. Due to more resolutions, in order to prevent players from accidentally touching the interface outside the window, the function of locking the cursor in the window has been added during the game. The cursor can be unlocked by opening any in-game menu.

notes.title: 23/11/26 Update
notes.notes:
[b]Bug fix[/b]

1. Fixed a bug where engineers were unable to shoot with Gatling

2. Fixed a bug where the mob icon does not appear when unlocking the mob after ending the game

3. The sources of electric shock and flame damage can now be accurately calculated to avoid errors in the ratio of summon damage to player damage

[b]Adjustment[/b]

1. Added lower resolution, now the game supports two resolutions: 1920 * 1080 and 1600 * 900, each supporting full screen and window mode switching

notes.title: 23/11/22 Update
notes.notes:
[b]Bug fix[/b]

1. Fixed a bug where melee weapons were unable to trigger some special effects

2. Increased the triggering probability of the effect of picking experience points to replenish ammunition (if activated)

3. Fixed a bug where black and white pharaohs were hit without changing their color

[b]Adjustment[/b]

When the Dragonfly Squad activates the healing function, the Dragonfly Squad will only move within a small range of players, thereby increasing the healing effect

notes.title: 23/11/22 Update
notes.notes:
[b]Bug fix[/b]

1. Fixed a bug where opening the pause interface caused the volume to be set to 0

2. Fixed a bug where some sound effects were not affected by volume settings

3. Added a simple flag for language selection on the title page

4. The announcement on the title interface supports multilingual versions



[b]Adjustment[/b]

1. Flies can now experience falling

2. Balanced the zombie generation rate of the forest cemetery level



We have reopened the demo entry on the Steam store page. The demo is a simplified version that only supports a few upgrade options, characters, and weapons, with slightly different clearance conditions.

notes.title: 23/11/21 Update
notes.notes:
1. Reduced the mobility and health of the basic zombies in the Forest Cemetery level, reducing the overall difficulty of the level

2. Reduced the generation speed of basic zombies in the Forest Cemetery level, reducing the overall difficulty of the level

3. Greatly reduces the difficulty of unlocking characters, making it easier for players to unlock characters other than cowboys

4. Fixed a bug in the Forest Cemetery level where the Fly Lord appeared and no matter how long the player waited, they were unable to win. We apologize for any players who experienced a bad experience due to this bug.

5. Adjusted the probability of obtaining various quality upgrade options during upgrade. There are three types of upgrade options available, which are red (optimal), yellow (suboptimal), and white (normal). Currently, the optimal upgrade option has a 10% chance of appearing, the suboptimal upgrade option has a 20% chance of appearing, and the normal upgrade option has a 70% chance of appearing.

6. (Important) Provide players with an additional upgrade option based on their tendency to upgrade, which has a high probability of meeting their upgrade direction. This option is located at the end of all upgrade options. Avoid players constantly being unable to find upgrade options that meet their needs.

notes.title: 23/11/20 Update
notes.notes:
[b]Bug Fixing:[/b]
1.Fixed a bug where the English version of some selected achievements on the achievement display page was in Chinese.
2.Temporarily closed a node that caused the enemy's speed to be abnormal.
